Solara — (9.9) PROTOSTAR

FIRST CONTACT

"One was humming Constantly"

[Verse 1] The shadows never arrived At least not immediately The distant shapes slowed Then stopped Then changed direction Polaris watched them leave The crew watched Polaris The situation remained suspicious But less urgent For now

[Pre-Chorus] Then another light appeared Far across the sky Not hostile Not familiar Not darkness Something else Someone else Approaching

[Chorus] First contact Across the folds at last First contact The distance closing fast New allies New stories New names beneath the stars First contact The war grows larger now

[Verse 2] The figures landed nearby Six of them Ancient Powerful And immediately strange

One was humming Constantly

[Persy:] Is that intentional?

[META:] Probably.

[SERAPHY:] La la la la la la la

[Chorus] First contact Across the folds at last First contact The distance closing fast New allies New stories New names beneath the stars First contact The war grows larger now

[Verse 3] Mikel crossed his arms Looked around once Then twice Then looked directly at Herc

[HERC:] Correct.

[MIKEL:] Aggressively.

[HERC:] I don’t think I did.

Long silence.

[HERC:] Alright.

[Bridge] Crotus produced soup. This surprised no one.

Crotus offered soup. This surprised the new ones

[JHOEL:] Is it flammable?

[CROTUS:] No.

[JHOEL:] Good.

The soup immediately caught fire.

[JHOEL:] Ah.

[CROTUS:] How.

[JHOEL:] I am a recurring issue.

Everyone looked at Gabie.

[GABIE:] I have urgent news.

[CASSIE:] You are late.

[GABIE:] I know.

[CASSIE:] How late?

[GABIE:] Difficult question.

[GABIE:] Thank you.

[Final Chorus] First contact The crews together now First contact The war moves forward somehow New allies New stories New names beneath the stars First contact The road is changing now

[Outro] The two crews stood together For a moment

The war felt smaller With more people facing it

[SERAPHY:] Na na na na na na na

[Persy:] What does that mean?

[META:] I know.

Long pause.

[META:] I am not confident enough to answer.

[LUCIE:] It means we’re helping.

[META:] That was my answer.

[LUCIE:] Eventually.

Far below Level One waited.

Solara’s Decision

Solara looks at them and says:

“Ok follow us.” “We’re heading back.”

Nobody objected. They had reinforcements now. Probably. Maybe.
